structurally related molecule when predicting whether systemic administration produces meaningful CNS access.

uninterpretable, it measures the wrong property or route, or it is not
compound-specific experimental evidence. Do not exclude merely because the
evidence is indirect, low-priority, from another species or assay model, or may
transfer weakly. If uncertain, include it.

The samples illustrate the shared bucket identity. Do not judge sample count,
repetition, or unusually detailed examples.
